title: Wait fan-in test gaps
description: gyz review finding 8, on top of herdtest: duplicate terminal events for one pane (three-subscription design guarantees them — pin settle dedupe + OnSettle-once), stream death after partial delivery (mid-wave), stray non-status events reaching consume ignore paths. Also add a local deadline to the client idempotent-close drain loop (review nit v) so a regression fails by name, not package timeout.
acceptance_criteria: All three gap scenarios pinned; drain loop failure is a named assertion
